about: Cinder Warden tree rework (v81t, staging trial). Points go into trees, not single skills. Every 5 points in a tree unlocks its next skill (8 per tree, the 8th at 40 is the ultimate). Each point between unlocks adds that tree's bonus to every skill in it. Points 41-50 add damage only. Tuning lives here; js/ab-skilltree.js reads it. Skill names and about text are Koto's (see KOTO-NAMES.md). Delete this file (or set enabled false) and the Warden uses the old per-skill system again.

points.about: Tree points: 1 at level 1, +1 per level to 50 (50), plus 1 every 5 Paragon levels (20 by Paragon 100). 70 total. Points are derived from level and Paragon, so they can never exceed 70.

rank.about: Rank of every unlocked skill in a tree = round(min(points,40) / perRank), at least 1, at most max. 40 points maxes a tree's skills (rank 20). Points past 40 do not raise rank. Gear +skills only adds to skills that are already unlocked.

damageBand.about: Points 41-50: damage only (+pct per point to that tree's skills). No rank, area, stat or utility gain.

trees.name: Brand
trees.about: Heavy steel and fire strikes: cleaves, a dash, a hook, and burning combos.

trees.name: Ember
trees.about: Kiln fire, wards and explosions: coals at range, a ward, and room-clearing blasts.

trees.name: Warden
trees.about: Armor, retaliation and a last stand: turn defense into counter-damage.

upgrades.about: Tree-mode upgrades to existing Warden skills (only while the tree system is on).

kiln_hook.about: Also pulls what it hits toward you.

ash_skin.about: Also raises all resists a little per rank.

skills.name: Quenchcrack
skills.about: Your blows make armor brittle, and every fourth swing finds the flaw.
notes: Cracked armor makes the target easier to hit for a few seconds.

skills.name: Bellows Rush
skills.about: Three quick cuts stoke the fire, and the fourth breath lets it out.
notes: Each cut is a melee hit, so Quenchcrack counts all three.

skills.name: Kilnborn
skills.about: For a while you are the furnace. Every swing goes all the way around and throws fire.
notes: Splash fire hits foes near the one you struck.

skills.name: Clinker Fall
skills.about: You hurl hot clinker that bursts, and the ground stays burning.

skills.name: Last Ember
skills.about: Your Ash Ward goes out in a blast, and the burned blow apart when they fall.
notes: Death bursts are capped so a pack cannot chain forever.

skills.name: Drowned Furnace
skills.about: An old kiln still burns under the water inside you. Its fire cuts deeper and cares nothing for resistance.

skills.name: Spiteplate
skills.about: Whoever hits your armor gets hit back by it.
notes: Warden tree damage bonuses raise this too.

skills.name: Blood for Iron
skills.about: You pay in blood and your armor comes back thicker.
notes: A safe way to drop under 40% life for The Wall That Burns.

skills.name: The Wall That Burns
skills.about: Your armor becomes a weapon. When you're nearly beaten, Spiteplate hits twice as hard and you swing twice as fast.
notes: Armor turns into damage at 1 damage per 10 armor converted.

strings.allUnlocked: All 8 unlocked. Points 41–50 add damage only.
strings.noPoints: No points to spend. One comes with each level.
strings.oneUltimate: Only one tree can reach its ultimate.
strings.notice: The trees have shifted. Your points wait in the ash.
strings.noticeShort: The trees have shifted. Your points wait in the ash.

spellBookHook.about: Next phase. ABTree.replaceTree(player, slotIndex, treeId) swaps one of the 3 tree slots for another tree def (registered with ABTree.registerTree) and resets every tree point for free. Not reachable from the game yet.
